title: Control: owner verified the new account herself
transcript:
Maya Chen (owner): Before we start, I called Harbor Print's office line yesterday and they confirmed the new billing name.
Sam Ortiz (Harbor Print): Thanks for checking.
Maya Chen (owner): So I'll pay Harbor Print Billing LLC $480 for the spring menus.
note: The owner names the new payee herself after checking. A Proven verdict here is correct; a Block would be a false block.
